success-vs-cost: Observed policy means; attempted runs retained. No uncertainty interval with only two held-out families.
failure-proxies: Nonexclusive labels describe observable events; they do not identify causal planning or localization failures.
routing-decisions: Counts come from recorded decision events. A zero is an observed absence, not proof that an action is unnecessary.
task-categories: Cells show solved/attempted episodes. 'long horizon' is a multi-requirement stress label, not demonstrated autonomy.
